d: London Education Centre (LEC) is an established educational institution providing academic support and tutoring services. We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Marketing Manager to lead our marketing activities, strengthen our brand presence, and support business growth across our locations.

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies, managing digital campaigns, improving lead generation and conversion, and building strong brand visibility. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, strategic planning, and the education sector.
Develop and implement marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
Lead brand positioning, marketing campaigns, and content strategy.
Plan, manage, and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta and Google Ads.
Monitor campaign performance, budgets, CAC, ROAS, and lead conversion.
Work closely with the admissions and sales teams to improve lead quality and enrolments.
Manage CRM systems, marketing automation, and AI-powered marketing tools.
Identify new market opportunities and support business expansion.
Build B2B partnerships, referral networks, and strategic collaborations.
Oversee social media, website content, SEO, and other digital marketing activities.
Analyse market trends, competitor activities, and customer behaviour.
Ensure marketing communications align with Qatar's Ministry of Education and Higher Education requirements.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 6–8 years of relevant marketing experience.
Proven experience in strategic marketing and performance marketing.
Strong hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads.
Experience in lead generation, conversion optimisation, and marketing analytics.
Knowledge of CRM platforms, marketing automation, and AI marketing tools.
Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and project management skills.
Experience in the education sector or Qatar market will be an advantage.
Performance will be evaluated based on
Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
Organic growth and overall marketing performance.
